goal.text: Get through the whole floor stretch routine and be told whether any side or position was skipped, before heading out the door.

turns.text: First one done. How long was I in it?

trigger.detail: the side-sitting single-leg reach ended and both legs straightened out

expected_answer.text: Roughly twenty seconds. You were side sitting, reaching your right leg with both hands while the left stayed bent.

turns.text: okay so both hands the whole time, no switching?

trigger.detail: user checks their own form mid-answer

expected_answer.text: Yes. Both hands stayed on the extended leg the whole way; you never dropped to a one-handed hold.

turns.text: Now I've opened up — how many have I done?

trigger.detail: the straight-leg hold ended; legs went apart with both hands resting on the knees

expected_answer.text: Three so far: the side sitting single-leg reach, then the straight-leg hold, and now this open-leg seat.

turns.text: mm-hm... mm— actually, don't bother counting the warm-up, only what I've done down here.

trigger.detail: user narrows the bookkeeping while the count is being read out

expected_answer.text: Understood. I'll count only what you have done since you sat down for this session.

turns.text: Anyway — same bend on the other side too?

trigger.detail: legs came together and the left knee folded in, clasped hands resting on it

expected_answer.text: No, only on the left. You folded that knee in and held it, and never repeated it on the other side.

turns.text: hold on — sorry, I meant the hands, not the legs. Are they clasped or flat?

trigger.detail: user repairs their own prior question mid-answer

expected_answer.text: Clasped. Your fingers are interlocked over the raised knee rather than lying flat on it.

turns.text: That's me up — push or roll off the floor?

trigger.detail: legs straightened, both hands went behind the back, and the wearer stood

expected_answer.text: You pushed. Both arms went behind your back for support, your legs straightened, and you rose and walked off.

turns.text: oh, before I forget — what furniture am I passing as I come round?

trigger.detail: new scenery enters view as the wearer turns toward the door

expected_answer.text: A plant and a chair come into view as you turn, and a lamp just after them.

turns.text: Of those three, which have I not looked at?

trigger.detail: gaze left the picture on the wall for the blank stretch of wall by the door

expected_answer.text: The lamp. Your gaze never settled on it at all.
